logger.message: Creating customer with PAN #[payload.panNumber] and Mobile #[payload.mobileNumber]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { customerNumber: "CUST" ++ (now() as String {format: "yyMMddHHmm"}), firstName: payload.firstName, lastName: payload.lastName, gender: payload.gender, dateOfBirth: payload.dateOfBirth, mobileNumber: payload.mobileNumber, email: payload.email, aadhaarNumber: payload.aadhaarNumber, panNumber: payload.panNumber, addressLine1: payload.addressLine1, addressLine2: payload.addressLine2, city: payload.city, state: payload.state, pincode: payload.pincode, occupation: payload.occupation, employmentType: payload.employmentType, companyName: payload.companyName, monthlyIncome: payload.monthlyIncome, monthlyExpense: payload.monthlyExpense, accountNumber: payload.accountNumber, accountType: payload.accountType, kycStatus: "Pending", customerStatus: "Active" }

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO customer ( customer_number, first_name, last_name, gender, date_of_birth, mobile_number, email, aadhaar_number, pan_number, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, pincode, occupation, employment_type, company_name, monthly_income, monthly_expense, account_number, account_type, credit_score, branch_id, kyc_status, customer_status ) VALUES ( :customerNumber, :firstName, :lastName, :gender, :dateOfBirth, :mobileNumber, :email, :aadhaarNumber, :panNumber, :addressLine1, :addressLine2, :city, :state, :pincode, :occupation, :employmentType, :companyName, :monthlyIncome, :monthlyExpense, :accountNumber, :accountType, 0, 1, :kycStatus, :customerStatus );

logger.message: Received request to fetch all customers.

db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_number, first_name, last_name, gender, date_of_birth, mobile_number, email, aadhaar_number, pan_number, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, pincode, occupation, employment_type, company_name, monthly_income, monthly_expense, account_number, account_type, credit_score, customer_status, kyc_status, created_date FROM customer;

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (customer) -> { customerId: customer.customer_id, customerNumber: customer.customer_number, firstName: customer.first_name, lastName: customer.last_name, mobileNumber: customer.mobile_number, email: customer.email, customerStatus: customer.customer_status, kycStatus: customer.kyc_status, createdDate: customer.created_date }

logger.message: Received request to fetch customer by ID #[attributes.uriParams.customerId]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_number, first_name, last_name, gender, date_of_birth, mobile_number, email, aadhaar_number, pan_number, address_line1, address_line2, city, state, pincode, occupation, employment_type, company_name, monthly_income, monthly_expense, account_number, account_type, credit_score, customer_status, kyc_status, created_date FROM customer WHERE customer_id = :customerId
